scope: Static website only; no deployment or installer publication performed by UI agent.

environment.browser: System Google Chrome 153.0.8010.50, headless, isolated profile
environment.csp: Local server applied nginx CSP with upgrade-insecure-requests omitted for localhost HTTP.

checks.name: Page identity and rendering
checks.details: Expected CodexMessenger title, meaningful retro page, no blank/error/overlay page.

checks.name: English default despite French browser and stale storage
checks.details: fr-FR context and codexMessengerLang=fr still render English at arrival without a supported explicit language query.

checks.name: FR and EN selectors
checks.details: Visible text, active aria-current, document lang and query URL change together without reload.

checks.name: History and explicit URLs
checks.details: Back restores French, reload preserves explicit French, Forward restores English, direct ?lang=fr is respected, unsupported ?lang=unknown falls back to English.

checks.name: Modal opening and focus
checks.details: Keyboard Enter opens from desktop trigger; close button receives focus; background content is inert.

checks.name: Modal keyboard loop and dismissal
checks.details: Shift+Tab from close reaches final Windows card; Tab returns to close; Escape closes and restores opener focus; modal reopens and backdrop click dismisses.

checks.name: Three platform links
checks.details: Apple Silicon arm64, Intel x64 and Windows x64 are visible. All point to official GitHub releases/latest and use target=_blank with noopener noreferrer.

checks.name: Mobile English and French
checks.details: French locale plus stale storage arrives in English at 390x844; explicit French selector updates URL and copy; mobile modal opens and Escape closes.

checks.name: Responsive bounds
checks.details: Document scrollWidth equals viewport width at 1440, 1024, 390 and 320 px; French mobile primary CTA has no internal horizontal overflow at 320 px. Three cards fit 320x568 modal.

checks.name: Media loading and page errors
checks.details: All inspected img elements loaded with naturalWidth>0; tracked desktop and mobile pages recorded zero JS exceptions, console errors and local HTTP errors/404s.

checks.name: Visual review
checks.details: Inspected final English desktop, French mobile and mobile three-platform chooser; typography, primary CTA, captions and cards are legible. Retained original retro visual identity.

checks.name: Source synchronization
checks.details: Four modified site files copied atomically and compared byte for byte in original and resident publication checkout; six durable screenshots copied to both.

limits: Local website QA does not prove deployed nginx headers, TLS or production content; root performs deployment verification.
External social pages were preserved as existing HTTPS destinations; their uptime was not tested.
GitHub releases/latest was readable and resolved v0.0.2.9 at this prepublication check. Release v0.0.3 installers are a pending root publication step, not a website QA claim.
Codex 0.156.1 primary release exists. App feature wording is based on repository validation; live voice still depends on account/server availability and microphone permissions.
